chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who performs salat (prayer) and recites the Qur'an while his face is covered with a litham, and he said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مُتَلَثِّمٌ: wearing a face covering with a litham

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) and recite the Qur'an while covering the face with a litham?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) and reciting the Qur'an while wearing a face covering. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that there is no problem with doing so, indicating its permissibility in this context.
